description: Source file implementing eSPI Out-Of-Band (OOB) communication handler with asynchronous support, including thread and timer management, for Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: request_temp
methods.description: Sends an OOB request to retrieve temperature data from the PCH.

methods.name: retrieve_packet
methods.description: Receives an OOB packet and extracts sender information.

methods.name: get_pch_temp_sync
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves PCH temperature multiple times.

methods.name: get_pch_temp_async
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves PCH temperature using a dedicated thread.

methods.name: temperature_timer
methods.description: Timer callback to set a flag for temperature retrieval.

methods.name: espihub_thread
methods.description: Thread function for processing asynchronous OOB responses and temperature requests.
